summary: Russia launched a massive multi-axis aerial attack across Ukraine involving dozens of Shahed-type reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets from multiple Russian airfields, targeting Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, and other regions. Ballistic missile threats from Bryansk region and Iskander-M systems were reported toward Kyiv. Ukrainian air defenses engaged numerous targets while Russian ground forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk region.
key_points: Dozens of reactive UAVs launched from Orel, Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye, Millerovo, Bryansk, Shatalovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk targeting multiple Ukrainian regions (Source: @eRadarrua/132492)
Geran-5 rockets struck Vyshhorod, Sarny, Korosten, Pavlohrad, Kryvyi Rih area, and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703)
Ballistic missile threat: Iskander-M launch from Bryansk region toward Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78715)

Kyiv under sustained attack with Shaheds targeting Holosiivskyi, Darnytskyi, Teremky, Nyvky Sady, Solomianka, Shulyavka, Lukianivka, Chabany, Obukhiv, Boryspil, Vyshhorod, Vasylkiv, Kozyn (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78711)
Enemy ground forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka per DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018)
Explosions reported at Russian Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk, Kaliningrad region (Source: @UkraineNow/85447)
Russian ship sinking near Gelendzhik in Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/85445)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive coordinated aerial assault across Ukraine on November 21, 2026, deploying dozens of Shahed-type reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets from at least seven Russian airfields including Orel, Bryansk, Millerovo, and Primorsko-Akhtarsk. The attack targeted Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Odesa regions simultaneously, with ballistic missile threats from Iskander-M systems in Bryansk region. Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple waves while Russian ground forces made tactical advances near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk region.

points: Ukrainian air defense units engaged reactive UAVs and Geran-5 rockets across at least 12 oblasts including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Odesa per real-time monitoring channels (Source: @eRadarrua/132506, @mon1tor_ua/78703).

Kyiv air raid alert activated at 20:25 with all-clear at 20:34; multiple Shaheds tracked entering Holosiivskyi, Darnytskyi, Teremky, Nyvky Sady, Solomianka, Shulyavka, Lukianivka, Chabany, Obukhiv, Boryspil, Vyshhorod, Vasylkiv, and Kozyn districts (Source: @eRadarrua/132507, @mon1tor_ua/78711, @mon1tor_ua/78712).

Geran-5 rocket impacts confirmed in Vyshhorod (Kyiv region), Sarny (Rivne region), Korosten (Zhytomyr region), Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk region), Kryvyi Rih area, and Zaporizhzhia city (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703, @mon1tor_ua/78705).
Ukraine and United Kingdom signed defense agreement for joint production of middle strike and deep strike drones with British financing and transfer to Ukrainian forces (Source: @UkraineNow/85454).
Chief of Defence Intelligence Kyrylo Budanov addressed nation on Day of Dignity and Freedom emphasizing unbreakable Ukrainian will (Source: @UkraineNow/85446).

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs from at least seven airfields: Orel (3-5 groups), Donetsk (2 groups), Gvardeyskoye (2-5 groups), Millerovo (2-4 groups), Bryansk (3 groups), Shatalovo (3 groups), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (9 groups) per launch detection reports (Source: @eRadarrua/132492, @eRadarrua/132494, @eRadarrua/132499, @eRadarrua/132514).
Iskander-M ballistic missile systems in Bryansk region prepared for launch toward Kyiv per high threat warning (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78715).

Geran-5 rockets fired from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod), from Kyiv region toward Zhytomyr (Korosten), from Chernihiv region toward Sumy (Nizhyn), from Kharkiv region toward Dnipropetrovsk (Pavlohrad), and toward Kryvyi Rih and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703).
Russian ground forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk region per DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Explosions and fire reported at Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk, Kaliningrad region with social media videos showing red sky and smoke (Source: @UkraineNow/85447, @UkraineNow/85450).
Russian cargo vessel reportedly sinking near Gelendzhik in Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/85445).
Enemy forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk region per latest DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Reactive UAV groups (2 groups) detected in Donetsk region moving toward Ukrainian positions (Source: @eRadarrua/132497).
Reactive UAVs (2 groups) operating in Kharkiv region near Izium-Barvinkove area (Source: @eRadarrua/132520).
Strike UAVs (3 groups) and reactive UAVs (2 groups) active in Kharkiv region per regional summary (Source: @eRadarrua/132515).
Reactive UAV tracked on eastern Kharkiv region toward Izium direction (Source: @kpszsu/98233).
Strike UAVs reported in Chuhuiv direction in Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/98218).
Reactive UAVs from Bryansk region (RF) entered northern Chernihiv region moving southward; additional UAVs tracked along Belarus border (Source: @kpszsu/98217, @kpszsu/98220).

Chernihiv region: multiple reactive UAVs tracked near Slavutych toward Kyiv region, near Sedniv southward, near Kulikivka and Nizhyn from north, near Pryluky, near Honcharivske, near Olyshivka/Kozelets (Source: @kpszsu/98230, @kpszsu/98217, @kpszsu/98201, @eRadarrua/132493, @eRadarrua/132488, @kpszsu/98219).
Reactive UAVs from Chernihiv region entered Kyiv region through Chornobyl exclusion zone heading west (Source: @kpszsu/98227).
Sumy region: 'Molniya' type UAVs detected (3 units per one report, 1 unit per another) (Source: @eRadarrua/132505, @eRadarrua/132500).
Reactive UAV from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Nizhyn district) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703).
Reactive UAV from Kyiv region toward Chernihiv region via Velyka Dymerka (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78714).

Zaporizhzhia region: reactive UAVs tracked near Vilniansk toward Dnipropetrovsk (Slavhorod), near Malokaterynivka, over Zaporizhzhia city from south and west, strike UAV (1 group) and reactive UAVs (2 groups) per regional summary (Source: @kpszsu/98196, @kpszsu/98206, @kpszsu/98235, @kpszsu/98211, @eRadarrua/132516).

Dnipropetrovsk region: reactive UAVs (3 groups) per regional summary; specific tracks near Solone westward, near Marhanets from northeast, near Kryvyi Rih from east, near Kamianetske from south (Source: @eRadarrua/132506, @kpszsu/98199, @kpszsu/98212, @kpszsu/98204, @kpszsu/98228).
Mykolaiv region: reactive UAV (1 group) per regional summary; tracked near Bashtanka toward Nova Odesa (Source: @eRadarrua/132501, @kpszsu/98223).
Kherson region: reactive UAVs (1-2 groups) per regional summaries (Source: @eRadarrua/132501, @eRadarrua/132516).
Odesa region: reactive UAVs (2 groups) per regional summary (Source: @eRadarrua/132497).
Russian naval losses: explosions at Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk, Kaliningrad; cargo vessel sinking near Gelendzhik (Source: @UkraineNow/85447, @UkraineNow/85445).

Massive coordinated UAV launch from seven Russian airfields: Orel (3-5 groups), Donetsk (2), Gvardeyskoye (2-5), Millerovo (2-4), Bryansk (3), Shatalovo (3), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (9) — all assessed as reactive UAVs (Shahed-type) (Source: @eRadarrua/132492, @eRadarrua/132494, @eRadarrua/132499, @eRadarrua/132514).

Geran-5 rocket attacks from multiple vectors: 5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod), 1 from Kyiv to Zhytomyr (Korosten), 1 from Chernihiv to Sumy (Nizhyn), 1 from Kharkiv to Dnipropetrovsk (Pavlohrad), 1 over Kryvyi Rih, 1 toward Zaporizhzhia, 1 hitting Sarny city (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703).

Kyiv under sustained multi-axis Shahed attack: 5 on Obukhiv, 5 from Poltava to Kyiv (Boryspil), 1 on Vyshhorod, 1 on Hlevakha, 1 on Vasylkiv, 1 on Kozyn, 2 in Holosiivskyi/Darnytskyi (Teremky, Nyvky Sady), 1 over Solomianka to Shulyavka/Lukianivka, 1 on Chabany (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78708, @mon1tor_ua/78709, @mon1tor_ua/78711, @mon1tor_ua/78712, @mon1tor_ua/78720).
Ballistic missile threat: Iskander-M launch preparation from Bryansk region toward Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78715, @mon1tor_ua/78716, @mon1tor_ua/78717).

Regional UAV counts per monitoring: Dnipropetrovsk (3 groups), Zaporizhzhia (1-2 groups), Kharkiv (2 reactive + 3-5 strike), Mykolaiv (1), Kherson (1-2), Odesa (2), Chernihiv (1-2), Kyiv (1), Rivne (1), Zhytomyr (1-2), Sumy (1-3 Molniya), Cherkasy (1), Poltava (multiple) (Source: @eRadarrua/132506, @eRadarrua/132497, @eRadarrua/132515, @eRadarrua/132501, @eRadarrua/132516, @eRadarrua/132502, @eRadarrua/132500, @eRadarrua/132505).
Air raid alerts: Kyiv alert 20:25-20:34; multiple regional alerts active during attack window (Source: @eRadarrua/132507, @eRadarrua/132512).

key_developments: Russia launched massive multi-airfield UAV operation from Orel, Bryansk, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Shatalovo, Donetsk, Gvardeyskoye targeting 12+ Ukrainian oblasts simultaneously (Source: @eRadarrua/132492, @eRadarrua/132494, @eRadarrua/132499, @eRadarrua/132514).

Geran-5 rocket strikes hit Vyshhorod (Kyiv), Sarny (Rivne), Korosten (Zhytomyr), Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk), Kryvyi Rih area, Zaporizhzhia city — 7+ confirmed impact locations (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78703).

Kyiv subjected to coordinated Shahed swarm: 15+ UAVs targeting 13+ districts including government quarter proximity (Chabany, Holosiivskyi, Darnytskyi) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78708, @mon1tor_ua/78709, @mon1tor_ua/78711, @mon1tor_ua/78712, @mon1tor_ua/78720).

sections.threat_assessment: The November 21 attack demonstrates Russia's capacity for large-scale, synchronized multi-domain strikes combining Shahed-type UAVs, Geran-5 rockets, and ballistic missile threats across Ukraine's entire strategic depth. Launch coordination from seven airfields indicates sophisticated command and control. The simultaneous pressure on Kyiv, northern border regions, eastern front, and southern oblasts aims to saturate air defenses and degrade critical infrastructure before winter. Ground advances near Novomarkove/Mykolaivka suggest continued attritional offensive in Donetsk. Baltic Fleet base explosions and Black Sea ship loss indicate growing vulnerability of Russian naval assets. NATO's Article 5 commitment to Poland after airspace violations signals alliance resolve.
sections.regional_response: NATO Secretary General Rutte affirmed alliance will defend every inch of Poland after Russian missile airspace violations. United Kingdom committed to financing and co-producing middle strike and deep strike drones with Ukraine, marking significant defense industrial integration. Trump administration reportedly pushing for Ukraine-Russia peace agreement by January 2027 before potential Democratic congressional control, with G20 summit in Miami (Dec 14-15) as possible negotiation venue. Ukrainian leadership maintains public resolve with Budanov's Dignity Day address emphasizing unbreakable will.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian launch pattern shows deliberate distribution across airfields to complicate interception and attribution. Geran-5 usage alongside Shaheds suggests mixed warhead types (thermobaric, fragmentation, penetration) for varied targets. Chornobyl exclusion zone transit route for UAVs exploits radar gaps near Belarus border. Kryvyi Rih and Zaporizhzhia targeting indicates focus on industrial and logistical hubs. DeepState's confirmed Russian advances near Novomarkove/Mykolaivka align with continued pressure on Pokrovsk axis. Baltic Fleet base attack — if Ukrainian — demonstrates growing long-range strike capability against Russian strategic assets far from front lines.
